Hi Priya,

Thanks again for agreeing to let us capture your implementation story — it will help other healthcare customers understand the latency and cost tradeoffs we solved together. Attached is a first-pass draft (redwood-implementation-story-v1.docx) and a dashboard screenshot we pulled for the metrics callout.

As a quick reminder, the things we need from you to finalize:
- Fact-check of the three metric callouts in section 2 (reduce average infer latency, token cost per request, and reduction in 99th percentile).
- Approval of the short quote we pulled from your post-rollout notes (we italicized it in the draft).
- Any legal redlines for the customer-facing doc (we can apply simple edits or accept a one-line approval from legal).

Can you review and send any edits by EOD Thursday (Dec 10)? If it's easier, mark changes in the doc and send back — we'll track and publish after sign-off.

Thanks — putting Aditya and Lauren on copy to help with metrics + quote language.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi Grace,

Thanks — I reviewed the draft and left inline changes in the attached doc. High level:
- Metrics: the latency improvement is accurate, but the cost-per-token number needs to be updated to reflect our post-quantization run. Please change the token cost from $0.004 to $0.0031 in the metrics table.
- Quote: the italicized quote is fine, but swap “production-ready in 2 weeks” to “production-ready in under three weeks” to be conservative.
- We removed a product name in paragraph 4 for privacy reasons (marked).

Legal is on copy; they'll chime in if they have formal redlines. I can sign off on the edits once legal gives the thumbs-up.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Engineering Operations
Vast Health

Hi all,

Quick legal/quotes update from my side:
- Legal reviewed the draft and is okay with a one-line publication approval. They asked that we include the following boilerplate above the quote: "Customer approved quote for public use; confidential operational details redacted." Please add that sentence in italics.
- On the quote itself, here's suggested final language that legal is comfortable publishing: "Redwood's runtime reduced our average inference latency by ~45% while lowering our token cost per request to an estimated $0.0031 — enabling us to ship a better patient triage flow faster."
- Headline tweak: change "Production in under three weeks" to "Production-ready in under three weeks" (Priya suggested conservative wording).

Aditya: confirm you updated the screenshot and attached the new PNG. If you could also generate the tiny table with before/after numbers (latency avg, p99, cost/token) we can drop it into the story.

I can send the one-line legal approval once the final doc is attached.

Thanks,

Hi everyone,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We've reviewed the updated draft and the revised screenshot — both look good. Legal has provided the requested one-line approval and is fine with the boilerplate.

Final approvals:
- Metrics table updated to show: avg latency 320ms (was 580ms), p99 reduced from 2.1s to 1.2s, token cost per request $0.0031.
- Quote to publish (PRIYA-approved): "Redwood's runtime reduced our average inference latency by ~45% while lowering our token cost per request to an estimated $0.0031 — enabling us to ship a better patient triage flow faster."
- Headline: "Production-ready in under three weeks"

Please proceed to publish and share the final PDF with our marketing lead (marketing@vasth.com). If you need a signature on a release form, we can route that through legal — but for now, this email thread serves as written confirmation to publish the case story.

Best,
